text:
incident-bot: PAGING: HIGH - us-east-1 external auth provider (token service) returning 502/504. Elevated 5xx across hosted API and several Dedicated pools in us-east-1. Error rate jumped from 3% -> 17% in last 90s. Graph: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/3932109999 :rotating_light:

mike (oncall): Taking. Observability shows spike coincident with third-party token rotation window. Reproducing 502 on STS proxied requests from control-plane.

sara (sre): Confirmed: control-plane logs show timeouts to https://auth-ext.example.com/token and retries saturating egress connections. KV cache misses increased.

julia (eng-runtime): Runtime is failing auth refresh path, we fall back to short-lived anonymous tokens which are throttled -> 502s on generate endpoints. Suggest increasing circuit-breaker and switch to cached token path.

mike (oncall): Immediate mitigations: 1) Enable token-cache fallback (flip flag) 2) Increase retry backoff and disable aggressive parallel refresh 3) Route new Hosted API traffic away from us-east-1 if latency > 800ms. Applying now.

mike (oncall): Runbook steps I'm executing: 
```
# toggle runtime flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://ops-api.internal/flags/token_cache_fallback -d '{"value":true}'
# reduce client parallel refresh
kubectl -n runtime patch deployment runtime-front --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","env":[{"name":"MAX_CONCURRENT_REFRESH","value":"4"}]}]}}}}'
```

ops-bot: deploy job started for runtime-front rollout (rollout #7652).

lisa (support): Notifying Tier 2 that we have elevated 5xx for Hosted customers in us-east-1. Preparing status page message. Potentially impacted: customers with low-region pinning and Dedicated pools in us-east-1.

kevin (product): Please include line for Dedicated customers and recommended workaround (move traffic to Dedicated in other regions or use fallback model alias).

julia (eng-runtime): Patch applied and rollout at 20% so far. Watching error rate. Also enabling prefix KV cache for token lookup to reduce STS pressure.

mike (oncall): Metrics: control-plane auth error rate down from 17% -> 9% after flag, hosted-api 5xx down to 8% from 12%, Dedicated pools still ~10% for some tenants. Continuing.

sara (sre): Contacting vendor support (auth-ext) via their pager and Slack channel. Sending correlation logs and request IDs.

sara (sre): Vendor responded: "we're in token rotation window, seeing elevated errors, mitigating; ETA 15-30m." They asked for request ID dump — sent.

mike (oncall): Ramp rollout to 60% after observing no regression on retries. Also temporarily overriding routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 for new traffic from the edge. Command: `routectl set-preferred-region us-east-1,eu-west-1 --preference=eu-west-1`

julia (eng-runtime): Note: forcing region fallback will increase p99 by ~80ms but reduces 5xx significantly.

lisa (support): Status page draft: "We are investigating elevated error rates in us-east-1 caused by a third-party identity provider rotation. Mitigations in progress; customers may see increased latency or errors. We'll update every 30 minutes." Approving.

kevin (product): Add note: "If you have pinned us-east-1 Dedicated capacity, consider shifting to alternative Dedicated region or enable multi-region fallback."

mike (oncall): Oncall handoff: tom will take after 30m. I'll leave a playbook pointer and current hits: we've applied token cache fallback, rollout at 80%, vendor ETA 20m, active mitigation holding.

tom (sre-next): Taking at 3932110200. I'll watch for vendor clear and rollback the edge region override once 5xx <1% sustained for 10m.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager silenced for oncall team to reduce noise. Next automated check at 3932110800.

sara (sre): Post-mitigation tasks: 1) run request ID replay to vendor 2) add better circuit-breaker metrics to trace 3) document token-rotation detection in runbook.

julia (eng-runtime): Followup config change req: exponential backoff bump and a short-lived token cache TTL of 30s during rotation windows. Will open PR.

lisa (support): Customer comms sent to impacted customers (template + links). No major PII.

mike (oncall): Closing main alert; keeping incident thread open for root-cause and RCA. If vendor clears and p50/p95 stable, we'll declare mitigated. Thanks team :thumbsup:

kevin (product): Good work. Please include the impact window in the RCA and list which Dedicated pools were affected (tenant IDs).

tom (sre-next): Will include log-correlations and timeline. Handoff complete.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. Duration so far 12m.
